skill.name: n8n-inbound-enrich
skill.description: Add contact and company details to n8n form submissions with Leadsets. Score leads against your ideal customer profile and prepare sales and nurture handoffs.
skill.summary: Enrich and score n8n form submissions for sales and nurture routing.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: The documented workflow sends lead data to Leadsets for enrichment. No evidence of shell execution, environment access, system reconnaissance, or prompt injection was found. The workflow can also write contact data to downstream destinations without requiring explicit approval or checking who can access them.

remediation.issue: Lead data is sent to a third-party enrichment service.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose which fields each Leadsets lookup sends and require operator approval before sending live data. Send only the fields needed for the lookup.

remediation.issue: Downstream writes lack destination approval and field limits.
remediation.suggestion: Default to a routing preview without writes. Require an approved destination and an allowed field list before sharing contact data.

content.user_title: Enrich and Route Inbound Leads in n8n
content.value_statement: Inbound forms often lack the details sales teams need to prioritize leads. Add contact and company details with Leadsets, then route submissions using your fit rules.
actual_capabilities: Checks Leadsets usage and sizes the batch before paid lookups.
Normalizes submitted emails, removes duplicates, and skips previously processed submission IDs.
Looks up each unique company domain and adds industry, headcount, and location when available.
Adds role, seniority, and work email status when Leadsets returns them.
Labels each lead as good fit, maybe, or no fit and records the reasons.
Returns a routing table or writes to connected destinations, then reports counts, usage, and queued work.
limitations: Live enrichment requires Leadsets MCP access or REST credentials and is subject to account limits.
The skill needs an n8n connection or submission payload. Writing to a destination also requires its own connection.
It does not send email or start outreach sequences.
It does not independently verify submitted addresses or look up other contacts at the company.

use_cases.title: Review demo request fit
use_cases.description: Score new demo requests against campaign criteria and review why each lead qualifies or needs more information.

use_cases.title: Prioritize the sales queue
use_cases.description: Send good-fit leads to an approved CRM queue with fit reasons, and hold leads with unknown email status for review.

use_cases.title: Prepare an n8n routing table
use_cases.description: Check field mapping on one lead and return fit labels that an existing n8n workflow can use for branching.

prompt_templates.title: Preview one submission
prompt_templates.prompt: Enrich this approved sample submission with Leadsets. Show the role, company details, and email status that were returned. Do not write to any destination.

prompt_templates.title: Score a small batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Deduplicate these approved demo requests before enrichment. A good fit is a US software company with 50 to 500 employees and a director or higher in sales. Return fit labels and reasons without writing to any destination.

prompt_templates.title: Route leads to approved destinations
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Process a batch with connected destinations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Enrich these new submissions using our approved Leadsets account. Send good fits to the approved CRM queue and send maybe and no-fit leads to the approved nurture sheet. Hold good fits with unknown email status for review.

prompt_templates.title: Backfill within usage limits
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Catch up on a larger submission backlog.
prompt_templates.prompt: Backfill last week's approved submissions, skipping previously processed submission IDs. Check Leadsets usage first, probe one lead, and look up each company domain once. Return a routing table and report which submissions remain queued.

output_examples.input: Preview fit for two approved demo requests without writing to downstream tools.
output: One lead is a good fit: a US sales director at a software company in the target headcount range.
One lead is a maybe because company headcount is missing.

output_examples.input: Enrich and route an approved batch of 12 submissions.
output: Read 12 submissions and skipped two duplicates.
Sent four good-fit leads to the approved CRM queue and held one good-fit lead for email review.
Sent three leads to the approved nurture destination and queued two for the next usage window.

best_practices: Use an approved sample to test enrichment fields and cost before processing a full batch.
Define fit rules explicitly and review leads with missing information before taking action.
Approve each destination and limit access and shared fields before routing live contact data.
anti_patterns: Sending real form submissions to Leadsets without approval for third-party processing.
Treating a submitted address or a catch-all result as verified.
Writing full lead rows to a broad Slack channel or shared sheet without checking who can access them.

faq.question: What do I need to run live enrichment?
faq.answer: You need a Leadsets account and an MCP connection or REST credentials. Provide submissions through n8n or pass the submission payload directly.

faq.question: What information leaves my workflow?
faq.answer: Leadsets receives lead identifiers and company domains for lookups. Connected destinations may receive contact details and fit reasons when you request routing.

faq.question: How does the skill score fit?
faq.answer: It compares industry, company size, country, job function, and seniority against your criteria. If important details are missing, the lead is marked maybe.

faq.question: Can I review the routing before any destination is updated?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask for a routing table only and explicitly request no downstream writes.

faq.question: Does the skill send emails or start sequences?
faq.answer: No. It prepares the handoff and preserves email status. Good-fit leads with unknown email status are held for review.

faq.question: What happens when the batch exceeds a usage limit?
faq.answer: The skill checks available usage and can queue work for a later window. The run summary identifies the remaining submissions.
